name: Torc Triath

attributes.attribute: a holder of a magic gift of Brigit

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Torc Triath is a king of the boars in the lore of Ireland. He holds a place in the tale of the gods. Some say a magic gift of the goddess Brigit was kept by him. The word torc means twisted, and it names a necklet worn by gods and nobles. He stands as the ruler of all the boars.

okr.objective: Record the king of the boars.
key_results: He is the king of the boars
He holds a magic gift of Brigit
